compat_seo_title: Free BaZi Compatibility Calculator for Two Charts
compat_description: Free BaZi compatibility calculator: enter two birth dates and times to build both Four Pillars charts and see how the Day Pillars and elements score.
compat_intro: Enter both people's birth details to build two Four Pillars charts. The reference score comes from how the Day Pillars relate and whether each chart holds the other's favorable elements, with every point listed.
compat_partner_note: The other person's birth details are used only for this calculation and are not saved by default. If you buy a full reading, they are stored with that report and deleted when you delete it. Please ask before entering someone else's details.
compat_desc_score: Starts at {base} and adds or subtracts points for each traditional rule in the table below, kept within 0–100. It shows which rules apply; it does not say whether two people suit each other or settle any question about marriage or love.
compat_desc_pillars: The calculation uses each person's Day Pillar and five element balance.
compat_breakdown: See how the score adds up
compat_unknown_time: {person}: no birth time entered, so this chart uses three pillars (year, month and day) and the element match counts six characters instead of eight.
compat_shared_note: This is a shared compatibility result. It contains only the score and the relations found, not either person's birth details. Enter birth details to calculate it again.
compat_unlock_partner_note: When you buy a full reading, both people's birth details are saved with the report so it can be generated and reopened. Deleting the report deletes them too.
compat_faq_q1: How is the BaZi compatibility score calculated?
compat_faq_a1: It starts at 60. A Day Master combination adds 15, a Day Branch six harmony adds 12 and a three harmony adds 8; a Day Branch clash subtracts 15 and a punishment subtracts 8. Each chart is then checked for the other person's favorable elements, worth up to 10 points each way. Every item is listed in the result.
compat_faq_q2: Does a low score mean we are a bad match?
compat_faq_a2: No. The score simplifies a handful of classical rules to compare two Day Pillars and element balances. It follows traditional methods, is for reference and self-reflection only, and does not predict the future. How a relationship goes depends on the people in it.
